tier_reason: Tier B stays on the independent Wild benchmark page; caveat corrected: the gdb-index row cannot have favoured lld since the runner aborts on unsupported flags.

corrections.caveats: Wild page (Ryzen 9 9955HX, GNU ld 2.46 vs LLD 21.1.8) runs lld at its default 16-thread cap (lld/ELF/Driver.cpp; its own best setting per commit a8788de1). The mold-gdb-index row's 12.1x more likely understates lld (runner aborts on unsupported flags, so GNU ld ran without --gdb-index or with unpublished per-linker flags). No gold rows or published inputs; near parity on tiny and LTO links; mold and wild several times faster. First-party ~2017 docs table not rerunnable (-no-threads flag removed). lld peak RSS 177 MiB vs 95 MiB GNU ld on ripgrep; archive semantics differ (--warn-backrefs); open #66974 exitLld race when embedded.

tier_reason: The yzia2000/qr_cpp_compiler run is a single cloud-VM run with a masked SKU, and its icpx flags (-xHost, -fp-model=, -fimf-precision, -qopt-zmm-usage) and the proprietary SVML/libimf runtime are absent from the open intel/llvm repo, so the result is not reproducible from public sources (flags-absent-from-public-sources precedent); the dominant SVI stage has a data-dependent iteration count that the validation never checks.

corrections.caveats: Single run on a masked cloud VM by a 0-star, AI co-authored repo. SVI stage (60-90% of the lead, derived from page data) has no transcendental calls, so the SVML explanation is wrong; its LM solver exits on data-dependent criteria and validate.py never compares iteration counts; the timed region includes 30M-quote bucketing. glibc 2.39 declares SIMD erf, so the gcc-stays-scalar explanation is wrong. icpx defaults to fp-model fast=1 with errno off; the benchmark's icpx flags are not in the open Options.td. Table ratio 1.49x, not the README's 1.44x. Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception for the open repo; the measured icpx binary is proprietary.
